title: Escape to Vietnam with Scenic Boat Ride to the Mekong Delta
highlights: Hanoi, the capital city of Vietnam, is a kaleidoscope of natural beauty, history, culture, and vibrant urban landscapes.
Marvel at the beautiful limestone structures over the azure blue waters of Halong Bay - a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Earlier known as Saigon, Ho Chi Minh City is a dynamic city offering exciting nightlife, authentic local delicacies, and artistic colonial buildings.
Get a shivering sensation as you watch the horror of the Vietnam War on the former battlegrounds at the Cu Chi Tunnels.
overview:
About the Tour:
Take this tour to a scenic country loaded with the best of natural beauty, splendid colonial structures, and delectable cuisine to treat your taste buds. Visit the capital city of Hanoi which is bestowed with both cultural and colonial architectural buildings and knows how to make a weekend count at its night market and walking street. Along with the urban beat of the capital city, get a chance to witness the marvelous archipelagos as you cruise on the azure blue waters of Halong Bay.
With vibrating energy, classic French architecture, age-old pagodas, and sleek skyscrapers, Ho Chi Minh City is a striking contrast between the old and the new. Owing to its rich history and turbulent past, the city is still seen as rooted in its culture and proudly boasts its history through war memorials and museums. Get an insight into the city's trembling past as you visit the Cu Chi tunnels, 75 km away from the city which once served as a battleground.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Hanoi
days.desc: Welcome to Vietnam! Upon your arrival at the airport, get transferred to the hotel and check-in. You can spend the remaining day as leisure or explore some of the famous attractions in the city like Hoan Kiem Lake, Ngoc Son Temple, and the Huc Bridge. Afterward, return to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

items.title: Check-in at Hm Boutique Hotel Hanoi at 02:00 PM

days.title: Excursion to Ninh Binh
days.desc: Prepare yourself for an excursion to Ninh Binh City. During this excursion, visit the historic capital of Vietnam, Hao Lu, and its ancient temples. Then, get on a boat from Hao Lu to Tam Coc, and explore its limestone caves. Next, cycle on quiet roads through villages to Bich Dong Pagoda. Afterwards, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Hanoi to Halong Bay Overnight Cruise
days.desc: Prepare yourself for an amazing cruise experience at Halong Bay, a renowned UNESCO Heritage Site. Check-out from the hotel and get transferred to Tuan Chao Harbour to board the cruise. During the wonderful journey, enjoy a visit to Ti Top Island, Duck Islet, and Pearl Farm Village. You can also enjoy kayaking along the shores of the bay. Also, take the Vietnamese cooking demonstration and learn how to make some traditional dishes. Afterward, enjoy your overnight stay on the cruise.

meals_hotel.location: Hm Boutique Hotel Hanoi at 02:00 PM

items.title: Check-in at Halong Royal Palace Cruise
Halong Bay Overnight Cruise on a Shared basis
items.desc:
Begin your overnight cruise from Tuan Chau Tourist Wharf in Halong Bay and receive a warm welcome with delicious lunch and drinks. 
Take a small boat to explore neighboring islands, relaxing at its coast or taking a swim, before proceeding to visit the Pearl Farm village for an interactive experience. 
Learn about the traditional dishes and flavors during your cooking class on the cruise.

days.title: Halong Bay to Hanoi | Transfer to Ho Chi Minh City
days.desc: Today, take the time to explore the wonderful Surprise Cave, before you disembark from the cruise at Tuan Chao Harbour. Afterward, get transferred to the Hanoi airport to board your flight to Ho Chi Minh City (flight tickets included). Upon your arrival, get transferred to the hotel and check-in. After you relax for some time, explore the city's famous places like the Ho Chi Minh Museum and War Remnants Museum. Later, head to the hotel at your own pace for an overnight stay.

items.title: Halong Bay Cruise
items.desc:
Start your day with sunrise, breakfast and a Tai Chi lesson on Sundeck.
Continue exploring Halong Bay by sailing across and visiting some of its major highlights, like the Surprise Caves.
Spend the rest of the time at leisure until you reach back on the coast of Hanoi.

days.title: Mekong Delta Day Trip
days.desc: Spend today's day exploring the Mekong Delta on a sightseeing tour. Get transferred from the hotel to see the stunning shrine of Vietnam, Vinh Trang Pagoda. Then, explore some of the bee farms and enjoy a visit to the Tortoise Islet, followed by a special lunch prepared by locals. Also, enjoy a boat ride along the shores of the Mekong River. Later, get transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.
